$comment: FICTIONAL fixtures for local testing only (never James's dreams). 9 dreams over 5 nights (1, 3, 2, 1, 2), mixed statuses, two nights far apart. seed-local.mjs loads them into wrangler dev's local R2 only; rendered ones point at the sample dream's GLB and world.

dreams.title: The sideways lift
dreams.raw_text: a lift that only went sideways, past floors made of the same blue tiles. the doors opened on a beach but the sand was cold carpet
I was in a library where every book was the same book and someone kept whispering the page number.

dreams.title: The car park under the house
dreams.raw_text: a car park under the house, which has never had a car park, and all the cars were facing the wall.
my phone had a new app called Tuesday and I couldn't close it.

dreams.title: Tram through the streetlights
dreams.raw_text: a long tram through a field of streetlights, nobody driving, the bell going every few seconds.
an argument about a bill at a restaurant that turned into a maths exam.
the old cinema was flooded to the seats and the film was still playing on the water.

dreams.title: Stairs in the ocean
dreams.raw_text: a staircase in the middle of the ocean, going down, warm air coming up from it.
I was late for an exam in a building I'd never been in, the corridors all slightly too narrow.
